stem.en: Which line matches an agent of gradation with its work?

feedback.en: Right. Groundwater works by dissolving rock.

text.en: Wind carves U-shaped valleys in high mountains.

feedback.en: U-shaped valleys are carved by glaciers. Wind shapes deserts.

text.en: Glaciers dissolve rock and make sinkholes.

feedback.en: Dissolving rock and making sinkholes is the work of groundwater.

text.en: Waves form the valleys and plains far inland.

feedback.en: Waves work along the coast. Running water forms valleys and plains.

explanation.en: Each agent has its own work: running water forms valleys and plains, glaciers carve U-shaped valleys, wind shapes deserts, waves shape coasts, and groundwater dissolves rocks such as limestone.

hints.en: Think about where each agent works: mountain, desert, coast or underground.
